release_notes:
## Fixes
- The mouse wheel actually scrolls the Episode Export tab now. The fix in 1.0.16 was itself broken — it asked the scrollbar how far it was scrolled, but that scrollbar is custom-drawn and has no such method, so every wheel event failed silently and nothing moved
- Dragging quickly across episode chips no longer skips the ones in between. The drag only ever checked where the pointer had landed, so a fast sweep across six chips would toggle two of them. It now follows the path taken between updates

## Also in this build
- Drag to add or remove works on the VFX tab's DETECTED EPISODES tags as well as the EXPORT QUEUE chips (added in 1.0.17)
